topic: CockroachDB query work and hot ranges
title: CockroachDB query work and hot ranges
brief: Reduce CockroachDB SQL and KV work without hiding a contention bottleneck.
outcomes: Locate lookups, fan-out, network work and contention
Weigh covering or distributed keys against write and ordering cost
entry: General plans, CockroachDB ranges and index contracts.

heading.title: From SQL to KV work
heading.brief: Inspect native EXPLAIN/ANALYZE output for a shop report; distinguish scanned keys, returned rows, lookup joins and distributed processors.

heading.title: A covering access path
heading.brief: Compare a secondary lookup with a stored-column index on the same workload; measure eliminated lookups, write amplification and space.

heading.title: Sequential and hot keys
heading.brief: Use synthetic order arrivals to expose range pressure; compare hash-sharded or alternative keys with their ordered-read and fan-out costs.

heading.title: Contention or capacity
heading.brief: Separate one hot stock row from a hot range, CPU pressure and remote latency; verify the repaired workload without extrapolating local timings to regions.
